features.title: Monorepo scaffold

npm run verify passes (lint, typecheck, unit tests in every workspace).
npm run dev serves the web app; the page shows the Thai app name.
npm run build produces the web build and the worker bundle.

features.title: Board model and FEN
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine can load and export Makruk positions in FEN, starting from rnsmksnr/8/pppppppp/8/8/PPPPPPPP/8/RNSKMSNR w - - 0 1.
verification: Unit tests: parse → serialize round-trips for the start position and 10+ varied positions.
Invalid FEN inputs are rejected with typed errors.

features.title: Move generation for all pieces
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine lists every pseudo-legal and legal move for Khun, Met, Khon, Ma, Ruea, Bia and promoted Bia.
verification: Unit tests per piece type from hand-built positions.
Illegal moves that leave own Khun in check are excluded.

features.title: Check, checkmate, stalemate, repetition
features.user_visible_behavior: The engine reports check, checkmate (win), stalemate (draw) and threefold repetition (draw).
verification: Unit tests with known mate, stalemate and repetition positions.

features.title: Bia promotion
features.user_visible_behavior: A Bia reaching the opponent's third rank becomes a promoted Bia that moves like a Met.
verification: Unit tests for promotion by push and by capture, for both colors.

features.title: Counting rules (Sak Kradan and Sak Mak)
features.user_visible_behavior: When counting rules apply, the engine tracks the count and declares a draw when the limit is reached.
verification: Scenario tests for board's-honour counting (no Bia left, limit 64).
Scenario tests for pieces'-honour limits: 2 Ruea 8, 1 Ruea 16, 2 Khon 22, 2 Ma 32, 1 Khon 44, otherwise 64.
Results cross-checked against Fairy-Stockfish makruk for the same move sequences.

features.title: Perft verification against Fairy-Stockfish
features.user_visible_behavior: Engine move counts match the reference engine, so rules cannot silently drift.
verification: Perft depth 1-5 from the start position matches Fairy-Stockfish.
Perft depth 1-4 from 5+ tricky positions matches Fairy-Stockfish.
Perft tests run in npm run verify (fast depths) and a slower script (deep depths).

features.title: Design system foundation
features.user_visible_behavior: The app uses consistent Duolingo-style tokens and components (chunky rounded buttons, cards, progress bars) in light and dark mode.
verification: Component showcase page renders all base components in light and dark.
Playwright screenshot of the showcase at 390px and 1280px widths.
docs/design.md describes tokens, components and the illustration style guide.

features.title: Thai default with English toggle
features.user_visible_behavior: The app opens in Thai; the user can switch to English and the choice persists after reload.
verification: Fresh load shows Thai UI and <html lang="th">.
Switch to English: UI updates immediately and <html lang="en">.
Reload: English persists.
Test fails if any key is missing from th or en locale files.

features.title: Board rendering
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees the Makruk start position on an un-checkered board with placeholder SVG pieces and coordinates.
verification: Open the play screen; verify 32 pieces in the correct start squares.
Board is responsive from 360px to desktop.
features.notes: Placeholder art; final art is art-001.

features.title: Tap and drag to move
features.user_visible_behavior: A user moves pieces by tap-tap or drag; legal destinations are shown and illegal moves are rejected.
verification: Playwright: tap a Bia, see legal dots, tap destination, piece moves.
Playwright: drag a Ma to a legal square works; drag to an illegal square snaps back.
Last move and check are highlighted.

features.title: Move list, history navigation and undo
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees the move list, steps back and forward through the game, and can undo in local games.
verification: Play 6 moves; move list shows 6 entries.
Step back 2 and forward 2; board matches.
Undo removes the last move.

features.title: Pass-and-play on one device
features.user_visible_behavior: Two people play on one device with a turn banner, optional auto-rotate or tabletop mode, and a game-over screen.
verification: Playwright: play a known short mating sequence; game-over screen shows the winner.
Auto-rotate flips the board after each move when enabled.

features.title: Game settings and time-control presets
features.user_visible_behavior: Before a game the user picks a time control (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical presets, no clock, or custom) and side; the last choice is remembered.
verification: Clock counts down with increment applied after each move; flag ends the game.
Reload: last-used setting is preselected.

features.title: Theme system
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can switch board theme and light/dark mode in settings; the choice persists.
verification: Switch between at least 2 board themes and light/dark; board and UI update.
Reload: choice persists.

features.title: Computer opponent in a Web Worker
features.user_visible_behavior: A user plays against the computer, which replies with legal moves without freezing the UI.
verification: Playwright: start vs computer, make a move, computer replies within the time budget.
UI stays responsive (animation keeps running) while the computer thinks.
features.notes: Own TS search first; Fairy-Stockfish WASM (GPL-3.0, allowed) for strongest levels.

features.title: Difficulty levels and bot personas
features.user_visible_behavior: A user picks from named bots of increasing strength.
verification: Automated match: each level beats the level below in a majority of 20 games.

features.title: Hints and takeback vs computer
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can ask for a hint (best move highlighted) and take back a move against the computer.
verification: Hint highlights a legal move; takeback restores the position before the user's last move.

verification: Lesson defined in data (JSON/TS) renders; correct move advances; wrong move shows feedback.

features.title: Guided first game

features.title: Reconnect, resign, draw offer, rematch

Resign, draw and rematch flows work end to end.
